task_name: Camp construction and visual upgrade system

integration_promotion.base_rule: exact current integration head that records T10 APPROVED and integrated

early_build_steps: Verify authoritative V2 plan includes BUILT_PENDING_DEPENDENCY.
Verify frozen T10 semantic contract is present at the prepared checkpoint.
Verify T11 planned paths are disjoint from T09/T10 and integration-only ownership.
Create havenline/T11-camp-construction from the verified T11 preparation checkpoint.
Build only T11-owned runtime/content/test paths against a semantic T10 mock/adapter.
Run T11 component, route/camera/context, build/import and performance-budget tests.
Record exact candidate source and unresolved dependency-sensitive tests.
Stop at BUILT_PENDING_DEPENDENCY until T10 is approved/integrated.
integration_promotion_steps: Verify authoritative integration branch is codex/havenline-sequential-task-01.
Verify T05 and T10 are APPROVED in dependency graph, workstream registry and task gates.
Verify the current integration head contains the accepted T10 completion/integration record.
Verify T10 is no longer listed as an active owner before T11 promotion.
Reconcile T11 build-pending adapter/recipes/tests against the exact accepted T10 public interface and completion source.
Apply the emitted @reservation:T11 PATH_OWNERSHIP patch through the integration owner.
Rebase or rebuild havenline/T11-camp-construction on the exact post-T10 integration head without losing approved T11 work.
Rerun dependency-sensitive integration tests, evidence, impacted regression and candidate guards.
Only then advance T11 to INTEGRATION_READY.
notes: Build-pending is not approval. Canonical integration remains dependency-gated until T10 is accepted.
T11 consumes the T10 public transform contract and may not change its transaction semantics.
T11 direct approved T05 bindings are hearth_vessel, pad_build and pad_upgrade; T05 source bytes remain immutable from T11.
T11 must not invent shipping camp prices from unrelated video labels or historical costs.
T12/T13 own progression/difficulty, T14 owns global persistence, T15+ own customer/production/combat/defense systems.
